name: Murayama Souichirou
source:
The principal of the school Atsuko teaches at and Yui attends. His son is Muriyama Kenji. He forces Atsuko to dress as an anime character with the excuse that it's to encourage good behavior from the students.

[spoiler]He wants Atsuko and Yui to become sex slaves for his students.[/spoiler]
